fieldValues.title: Programme code is scattered and bound to one programme
fieldValues.statement: The code that runs the programme lives in five places: the programme's own repository, the Rust engine repository, an unversioned parent folder, the clerk, and a second governance tool in the engine. Each piece hard-codes SemanticOps values such as repository lists, report issues, the board number and the owner. Agents cannot find a tool before they rebuild it, the documentation describes a board process that has moved on, and no second programme or governance editor can reuse the practice without copying code.
